system.description: When you resolve a set: with a joker and/or 7, +(SL) damage until your next turn; with a joker and/or 1, damage you suffer is reduced by (SL) before Affinities; with none of those, recover (SL × 2) HP immediately. A joker satisfying two rows is the player's choice.
